description: This file contains Cypress end-to-end tests for verifying charts rendering and interactivity in a web application, including checks for Chart.js and Recharts components, data updates, and error handling.
external_files: charts API endpoint URL (configured via Cypress.config('env').apiBaseUrl)

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by mocking API, logging in, navigating to charts page, and waiting for chart data fetch.

methods.name: it('renders Chart.js Line, Bar, and Pie charts and Recharts charts')
methods.description: Verifies that the primary chart components are visible, canvases for Chart.js exist, and Recharts SVG elements are present.

methods.name: it('updates data when filter changes and refresh clicked')
methods.description: Checks that changing filters and clicking refresh re-fetches data and canvases remain displayed.

methods.name: it('shows error notification when charts API fails')
methods.description: Simulates API failure and verifies that an error notification is shown.
